title: Quickstart

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They have Docker Compose and want to deploy DataStack from scratch.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: Stack is running, CSV processed automatically, SPARQL endpoint available.
steps: Prerequisites box — Docker Compose v2, Git, public-facing URL or LAN IP, 10 GB RAM
Configure .env — inline snippet of the 5–6 must-set variables
docker compose up — what to expect in logs (services starting order)
Create admin account + API token — exact CKAN UI path
Set BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN — !!! warning admonition, explain why jobs fail without it
Create mappings group — exact name 'mappings', case-sensitive !!! note
Upload test CSV — what appears in dataset (3–4 auto-created resources)
Optional: trigger Fuseki, open SPARQL via Sparklis

inline_assets_required.description: .env snippet: the 5–6 variables that must be set before first boot. Fetch from DataStack .env.example for real variable names. Must include: CKAN_SITE_URL, CKAN_SYSADMIN_PASS, BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN, and at least 2 CKANINI__ extension keys.
!!! warning for BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN — not just a bullet point. Explain: background jobs won't run, pipeline stalls silently.
!!! note for mappings group name — case-sensitive, must be exactly 'mappings'.

walkthrough_requirements.verify_label: ✓ Verify: CKAN home page loads at http://localhost:5000
✓ Verify: CKAN API responds with site status

quality_gate: All 9 story outline steps present in order
Inline .env snippet present with real variable names from DataStack repo
Every step has a '✓ Verify' indicator
BACKGROUNDJOBS_API_TOKEN is a !!! warning (not a bullet)
mappings group name is a !!! note with case-sensitive warning
notes: Page is partial — most steps are roughed in. Main gaps: real .env variable names (fetch from DataStack repo), docker compose log output description, exact CKAN UI paths for API token creation. datastack.json post_boot_setup section has the 5-step sequence to follow.

primary.goal: Get the stack deployed, configured, and running reliably.
